cohort: 7217 neonates who received abdominal ultrasonogram within seven days-of-life
finding: Neonatal adrenal hemorrhage (NAH) was more frequent in heavier infants delivered vaginally with vacuum extraction, often involving the right adrenal gland and resolving spontaneously before seven months of age.
mod_finding: Infants with NAH were more likely to be delivered via vaginal delivery with vacuum-extraction than cesarean section.
